content.storyline: Washington’s 22-20 win over Cincinnati kept its NFC East hopes alive, though it remains two games behind the Giants. Arizona enters after a 34-7 Week 11 loss to Kansas City and sits fourth in the NFC West.
matchup_notes: Washington beat Cincinnati 22-20 on Nov. 23, improving to 4-5-1.
Washington is two games behind the NFC East-leading Giants.
Arizona lost 34-7 at Kansas City in Week 11.
Arizona is 3-8, fourth in the NFC West, and has lost three straight.
